pages.title: Tachyon Resonator
pages.text: Resonates a crystal lattice until it emits particles that travel faster than light.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.

A $(thing)tachyon$() is a hypothetical particle that always moves faster than light; in the equations its mass comes out imaginary. No experiment has ever found one. This crystal, apparently, has not read the literature. I have checked the readings four times.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 1 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Tachyon Crystal, Tachyon Flux, Tachyon Klystron.
